products.name: macOS BYOD Management — Account-Driven User Enrollment, App Protection & Conditional Access — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a macOS BYOD strategy — account-driven user enrollment, Conditional Access that gates on compliance, and an honest app-protection model — to secure company data on personal Macs, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Secure company data on personal Macs without owning them

Personal Macs accessing company resources need protection without heavy-handed control over the user's device. This solution builds a macOS BYOD strategy: account-driven user enrollment for a lighter management footprint, Conditional Access that requires compliance/enrollment for access, and an honest treatment of what app protection can and can't do on macOS — so corporate data is protected on non-corporate Macs, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — BYOD models for Macs (account-driven user enrollment vs device enrollment vs unmanaged + Conditional Access), what management footprint each carries, and the honest note that Intune App Protection Policies do not cover macOS apps the way they do iOS/Android — protection comes via MDM scope + Conditional Access.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Entra + Intune, account-driven enrollment prerequisites, Conditional Access, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to enable account-driven user enrollment, scope BYOD compliance, build the named Conditional Access policy (require compliant/enrolled Mac), assign to a pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — BYOD-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/compliance validation, a BYOD access-posture report, safe remediation, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (personal Mac enrolls, compliant, CA allows) plus Best Practices for privacy and least footprint.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Company data protected on personal Macs — the right enrollment model and Conditional Access, without over-managing the user's device — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACBYOD-Discovery.ps1 — BYOD-readiness check for macOS account-driven user enrollment + Conditional Access
    • MACBYOD-Remediation.ps1 — create/repair the require-compliant-Mac CA policy and assign BYOD compliance. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • MACBYOD-Report.ps1 — BYOD access-posture report for macOS (enrollment model, compliance, CA gating)
    • MACBYOD-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — move BYOD compliance + CA scope from pilot to production. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • MACBYOD-Validation.ps1 — validate one BYOD Mac against the solution's acceptance gate

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
